Card Q&A.q: Can I use this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect to trash a card in my hand but then choose to not return a card from my trash to the hand?

Card Q&A.a: Yes, it triggers.  However, this effect can only be activated when that Digimon is blue.
Card Q&A.q: Does this card's [Your Turn] effect trigger even when my non-blue Digimon are played or digivolve?

Card Q&A.a: It references the Digimon after it digivolves.
Card Q&A.q: Does this card's [Your Turn] effect reference the card for the Digimon before or after it digivolves?

Effect: [On Play] [When Digivolving] By trashing 1 card in your hand, you may return 1 red or blue [Iliad] trait Digimon card from your trash to the hand.
[Your Turn] When your Digimon are played or digivolve, if any of them are blue, this Digimon may digivolve into [Flaremon] in the hand with the cost reduced by 1.
